text.en:
Hybrid melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield.
Generates energy on dealing ranged damage.

[Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield, depleting energy over time
[Melee]  : Kinetic melee combo

Glaive Melee and Projectile Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a sentient <solar/>Healing Turret.

import main from 4293542123

Only applies to Glaive Projectiles.
